votes.motion: A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Marci Houseman to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Marci Houseman to approve Resolution 22-01C, a resolution appointing and designating Council Members to the following Committees, Boards, and Commissions, as indicated in Exhibits A and B for a term beginning January 4, 2022 and ending when otherwise amended by action of the City Council
A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Ryan Mecham to recess to a closed session in the Council Conference Room, and adjourn the City Council meeting following the closed session

A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robsinson to ratify the results of the election of Council Member Marci Houseman as the Council Chair and Council Member Zach Robinson as the Council Vice-Chair
